chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm narrated from his father, and Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl from al-Faḍl ibn Shādhān, all together from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥafṣ ibn al-Bakhtarī, who said:
I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام say: “The hadd of the grave-robber is the hadd of the thief.”

key_terms.النَّبَّاشِ: the one who digs up graves, especially to steal from them

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a grave-robber in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling from Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام that the prescribed punishment for the grave-robber is the same as that of the thief. It places grave robbery under the legal treatment of theft and reflects the seriousness of violating the sanctity of graves and unlawfully taking property.
